sa_r3-sa58_children.desc: two children walking hand in hand (W6-3 modified), 276 x 247 — traced from the sheet at 1000 dpi

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet R3-SA58 (2015, 1:10; formerly R4-SA58): R3-SA58A 450 x 1555 illustrated (B 600 x 2070). One white blade with a pointed top: the sharp apex ('x') is 20 above the sign's top (527 + 600 + 448 = 1575 = 1555 + 20), shoulders 135 deg at 225 below the apex; ground transparent, the blade drawn as a white polygon. Corner radius R33 (Typ) is read as the orange ground's radius (4 / 12: white edge 4 + black border 8), so the outline is R45 — which puts the rounded apex 18.6 below the sharp point; the apex radius is set to 48.3 so that the top sits exactly at the stated 20. Top part (apex to 507): fluorescent orange pentagon inside the 4 edge and 8 border; children symbol 'W6-3 (modified)' 247 high, 98 above the part's bottom (y 162-409), 280 wide box (85/280/85) — traced from this sheet (it differs from the national W6-3 artwork), ink 276 x 247, centred. Middle (600): red ring outer dia 420 (90 below the pentagon: y 597-1017, centre (225, 807)), ring 36 wide measured (not dimensioned); 25 in 190 C, baseline 115 above the ring's bottom (top 712), ink 236 (107/236/107). Bottom part (448, y 1107-1555): panel with 4 edge + 8 border, WHEN / CHILDREN / PRESENT 75 C, baselines 133 / 125 / 125 below the panel top (tops 1165, 1290, 1415; 65 below), widths 219 (115/219/116), 396 (27/396/27), 356 (47/356/47). The drawing itself sits up to 5 mm off these chains in its upper half (pentagon and ring drawn slightly low); the stated dimensions are used. School zone limit in SA is 25 km/h (no other value).
